findings.title: grid_fee docstrings say the module is free of Home Assistant imports; it cannot import without homeassistant
findings.claim: grid_fee.py's module docstring (line 27, 'Kept free of Home Assistant imports so it can be unit-tested directly') and max_abs_component's docstring ('Pure and HA-free') are false: importing grid_fee with homeassistant absent raises ImportError, through currency.py's module-level `from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant`.
findings.mechanism: grid_fee imports currency.money_scale; currency imports homeassistant.core at module level for an annotation only (from __future__ import annotations makes it a string), so the HA-free property the docstring promises, and the reason it gives, fail transitively. The ten other HA-free claims in the cells hold.

findings.title: comfort_band docstring says the climate slider's maximum sits one degree above the ceiling; it equals the ceiling
findings.claim: comfort_band.py's module docstring states, in the present tense, that the climate entity's slider has 'its own maximum sitting one degree *above* the configured ceiling'; the real HeatPumpOptimizerClimate publishes max_temp equal to the configured max_temperature (overshoot 0.0 °C).
findings.mechanism: climate.py:124 sets _attr_max_temp = config.max_temperature since v5.1.7 removed the + 1 (its own comment at climate.py:110 says so); the comfort_band bullet still describes the old slider as current, so a reader of comfort_band alone believes the slider can still store a target above the ceiling.
